journey.name: profile removal recovery
journey.description: Use a disposable authenticated profile and controlled homeserver/operation/storage faults. These fault gates are outside the standard Capabilities; no live funds or wallet wipe is needed. Keep a redacted operation counter. Recreate the fixture separately for each failure checkpoint. Local Disconnect does not assert remote deletion. Conditional contact deletion across devices is not proved by local ownership, and requires the separate native CAS fixture. Failures before logout offer local Disconnect only: contact reads can reconcile writes and must not be used for remote Review. Separately lose the logout response after all preceding cleanup was acknowledged under a genuinely live grant. That case permits a freshly confirmed logout-only retry while its original process, owner and grant remain current. Record proof-request counts without retaining credentials or nonce values. An old bearer observer does not authorize retry.

actions.action: Open Edit Profile, request deletion and verify preparation opens a confirmation without destructive profile or contact mutation
Confirm once, lose a mutation acknowledgement and verify failure feedback without success or automatic replay
Verify no remote Retry or Review action is offered after uncertain contact or profile cleanup
In separate fixtures, edit the remote profile or change or add a contact after the failure; verify the app starts no further remote cleanup
Choose Disconnect from the failure options and verify a separate local-only confirmation appears
Cancel local Disconnect and verify neither local cleanup nor remote mutation runs
Confirm local Disconnect while credential erasure is unavailable and verify recovery remains pending without clearing consumed-payment-list safety state
Restore local storage, restart after credential erasure but before local completion and open Profile
Verify pending cleanup and Disconnect remain visible with no stored identity, no authenticated activation and no automatic remote mutation
Background and foreground the app, then reconnect the test device network; verify cleanup guidance remains available without an expired-session or reconnect-profile error
Confirm local Disconnect and verify all required local cleanup finishes before leaving Profile
In a fresh fixture, replace the sign-in before an old confirmation or completion is delivered and verify it cannot act on or navigate away from the replacement
Open ordinary receive and verify address accounting remains available while profile cleanup is pending
In the separate lost-logout-response fixture, verify Retry appears only after the prior native attempt and local tail return
Open Retry, cancel its fresh Disconnect Profile confirmation and verify no proof negotiation or remote mutation occurs

Confirm Retry once and tap again while its response is held; verify exactly one fresh proof attempt, the original removal UUID and grant, and no repeated private-list, public-endpoint, app, contact or profile cleanup or reads

Allow a same-grant bearer refresh and verify confirmed proof logout can still complete; replace the grant, identity, client, signer or same-seed process lifecycle and verify the old intent cannot act or erase replacement credentials

Lose another logout response without an acknowledgement and verify a new confirmation is required; record an acknowledgement before cancellation or local-storage failure and verify only local completion remains available
Restart after unknown logout and verify the persistent record offers only local Disconnect, with no grant recapture or SDK restoration for retry
Choose local Disconnect after unknown logout and verify it can retire the idle retry intent and finish; cancel during an active attempt and verify cleanup waits for its actual native tail

In a fresh controlled fixture, change stored credentials or the adopted source after unknown logout, attempt Retry to observe the mismatch, then restore the original values; verify the original retry remains unavailable, no native logout is dispatched and local Disconnect still works
